## Wave 5 Summary

This wave resolves the neutrino sector's two open compute legs carried forward from S99.

**Item 16 (S100a-MD-NORMALIZATION)** is the registered successor `CF-S100-MD-NORMALIZATION` to my own S99 W3-2 gate (`S99-W3-SEESAW-SUMMNU`, PASS, `Sigma_mnu_FW = 0.0582053272 eV < 0.072 eV` DESI). The S99 PASS carried an HONEST-SCOPE caveat (the `dual_prior` track_B): the Dirac Yukawas `Y_i` were *back-solved* from the oscillation-anchored light masses `Y_i = sqrt(2 m_i M_i)/v`, so the absolute `Sigma_mnu` was the minimal-normal-ordering value *consistent with* oscillation data, NOT a genuine zero-free-parameter substrate output. The substrate-FIRST content was `M_R` (the B-branch `D_K` fold energies), the seesaw STRUCTURE, the suppression DIRECTION, and normal ordering. Item 16 inverts the inference: pin `Y_i` FORWARD directly from the substrate `D_K` bottom light-triple (the ~0.82-0.87 M_KK E1/E2/E3 set that `S96-MATTER-R-HIERARCHY` read as `R_direct = 9.86`), uniquely map the bottom-triple to `Y_i`, RE-COMPUTE `Sigma_mnu` as a genuine zero-free-parameter prediction, and re-gate vs DESI. The discriminator is whether the bottom-triple to `Y_i` map is UNIQUE (zero-free-parameter PASS) or admits a residual Dirac-scale normalization freedom (INFO confirming track_B is structurally irreducible).

**Item 17 (S100a-D5-0NUBB-MAJORANA)** is the register-sourced compute leg of the unreconciled capstone §7.3 D5 "no-seesaw" tension, SHARPENED by the S99 W3-2 seesaw PASS that USES a right-handed Majorana `M_R`. It computes the 0νββ effective mass `m_ββ = |Σ U_ei² m_i|` from the substrate KO-dim-6 Pfaffian Majorana texture (the `M_3(ℂ)` summand; `delta_CP ∈ {0,π}` forced by `[J,D_K]=0`; normal ordering `m₁=0`; the S99 mass triple `[0, 0.0086776, 0.0495278] eV`) and places it against KamLAND-Zen 2024 + the LEGEND-1000/next-gen forecast. This is the laboratory Majorana-vs-Dirac discriminator. SCOPE PIN (load-bearing): this gate supplies the OBSERVABLE leg ONLY. The MATH/prose adjudication of D5 — capstone §0 "no-seesaw" framing vs the Majorana `M_R` the S99 seesaw uses — is a workshop question (`Investigating-Workshops.md §Q1`); the capstone §7.3 STATUS stays `unreconciled` regardless of this gate's verdict. The verdict tells us whether the substrate's neutrino IS Majorana (seesaw stands, §0 framing falls) at a falsifiable LEGEND-reach magnitude, or whether `m_ββ` sits below all forecast reach (the discriminator is deferred to the experiments). Any falsifier-master-inventory row routes to `mack-cosmic-bridge` (sole writer) at session close.

Both gates are COMPUTE-class (numerical PASS/FAIL/INFO threshold against pre-registered bounds), PARTICLE classification. Wave 5 is INDEPENDENT of all other S100a waves (partition manifest §"Cross-wave dependency graph").

## Wave 5 Decision Point Prerequisites

NONE. Wave 5 has no upstream-verdict prerequisites from S100a prior waves or S99. All inputs are static on-disk artifacts (S55/S60/S84/S96/S99 `.npz` + `s96_matter_0nubb.py` machinery) plus `canonical_constants.py` pins that already exist (verified at plan-freeze via the knowledge MCP — see Input-SHA Ledger). No item in this wave invokes a mechanical-closure path: there is no prereq that could be unmet at dispatch.

Cross-axis dispatch note (not a verdict prerequisite): Item 16 admits `connes-ncg-theorist` as the cross-axis reviewer for the Dirac-side `D_F` texture (whether the bottom-triple to `Y_i` map is forced by the finite Dirac operator's representation structure). Item 17 admits `dirac-antimatter-theorist` as the cross-axis reviewer for the KO-dim-6 Pfaffian Majorana determination. These are derivation-author cross-axis tags, not blocking dependencies.

```yaml
        m_{D,i} = Y_i v_ew / sqrt(2). Two candidate maps are pre-registered as competing reductions of

          MAP-A (eigenvalue-proportional): Y_i proportional to E_i (the raw D_K bottom eigenvalue),
                normalized by a single overall Dirac scale Y_ref pinned to E_ref = E_1.
          MAP-B (Casimir-graded): Y_i proportional to sqrt(C_2(p_i,q_i)) of the triality-distinct tower
                the bottom-triple occupies, per the S96 sector-assignment.
        The map is UNIQUE iff MAP-A and MAP-B yield Sigma_mnu agreeing to within tol_uniqueness with

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The substrate-forward seesaw SUPPRESSES the light mass (heavier M_R -> lighter m_nu),
            so substrate-forward Y_i pinned by the bottom-triple drive Sigma_mnu DOWN into the
            sub-0.072-eV DESI-consistent regime; the [SIGN] direction is identical to S99."

    Step 1 — Definitions:
      m_{D,i}     = Y_i * v_ew / sqrt(2)        [Dirac mass; v_ew = 246 GeV canonical]
      Y_i         = substrate-forward map of the bottom-triple E_i  [MAP-A: Y_i prop E_i ; MAP-B: Y_i prop sqrt(C_2)]
      M_i         = M_R,i = (B-branch D_K fold energy)_i * M_KK   [M_KK = 7.428660036284456e16 GeV canonical]
      m_{nu,i}    = m_{D,i}^2 / M_i             [type-I seesaw, aligned/diagonal basis]

    Step 2 — Substitution (seesaw suppression derivative, no simplification):
      d m_{nu,i} / d M_i = d/dM_i [ m_{D,i}^2 / M_i ]
                         = m_{D,i}^2 * d/dM_i [ M_i^{-1} ]
                         = m_{D,i}^2 * ( - M_i^{-2} )

    Step 3 — Simplify (algebra, one step per line):
      = - m_{D,i}^2 / M_i^2
      with m_{D,i} >= 0 (real Yukawa, [J,D_K]=0 => M_R real) and M_i > 0 (fold energy > 0)
      => numerator m_{D,i}^2 >= 0, denominator M_i^2 > 0, leading sign is the explicit minus
      => d m_{nu,i} / d M_i < 0  for i=2,3 (strictly; i=1 is 0 since m_{D,1}=0, m_1=0)

    Step 4 — Direction read-off (from canonical form):
      d m_{nu,i}/d M_i = - m_{D,i}^2 / M_i^2 < 0  => heavier M_R gives lighter m_nu (suppression).
      M_R is placed at the M_KK scale (~1e17 GeV) by the B-branch fold energies; the suppression
      ratio m_D/M_R ~ 1e3 GeV / 1e17 GeV ~ 1e-14 (deep seesaw, in regime). Sigma_mnu is driven DOWN
      to O(0.06 eV) < 0.072 eV.

    Conclusion: The [SIGN] direction (suppression, delta = Sigma_mnu - bound < 0) is structurally
                identical to S99; the substrate-forward Y_i change the ABSOLUTE Sigma only through
                the bottom-triple normalization, which is precisely what the uniqueness test
                interrogates. sign_verdict = PASS iff delta < 0 AND all d m_nu/dM < 0 (i=2,3).
```

```yaml

  step_size: "Majorana-phase grid 2pi/240 (alpha_2) x 2pi/40 (alpha_3); diagnostic"
  tolerance: "tol_majorana_detect=1e-12 (KO-dim-6 Pfaffian Majorana nonzero-detection floor, S96); tol_bound is the publication precision of the bounds (3 sig figs)"
  scheme: "KO-dim-6-Pfaffian-Majorana-on-H_K+ (S96-MATTER-0NUBB machinery) + S99-oscillation-anchored-m_i Route-A"

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The substrate-pinned 0nubb central m_bb (zero Majorana phase, delta_CP=0) is a POSITIVE
            sum of non-negative terms (no cancellation), so the central value sits at the upper edge of
            the NO funnel and is the cleanest comparison point against the bounds; m_bb^{central} <
            0.122 eV (KamLAND-Zen) is the PASS direction."

    Step 1 — Definitions:
      m_bb        = | Sigma_{i=1}^{3} U_ei^2 m_i |      [0nubb effective Majorana mass]
      U_e1^2      = c12^2 c13^2                          [PMNS electron row; c=cos, s=sin]
      U_e2^2      = s12^2 c13^2
      U_e3^2      = s13^2 * exp(...)                     [Dirac phase absorbed; delta_CP in {0,pi} substrate-forced]
      m_1         = 0                                    [normal ordering, rank-deficient lightest, PROVEN]
      m_2         = 0.0086776 eV                         [S99 oscillation-anchored, s99_w3_seesaw_summnu.npz]
      m_3         = 0.0495278 eV                         [S99 oscillation-anchored]
      sin^2(theta_12) = 0.307, sin^2(theta_13) = 0.0220  [NuFit-6.0 NO, laboratory-IN pins]

    Step 2 — Substitution (central value: m_1=0, all Majorana phases = 0, delta_CP=0):
      m_bb^{central} = | U_e1^2 * 0  +  U_e2^2 * m_2  +  U_e3^2 * m_3 |
                     = | s12^2 c13^2 * m_2  +  s13^2 * m_3 |

    Step 3 — Simplify (substitute the NuFit numbers, one step per line):
      c13^2 = 1 - 0.0220 = 0.9780
      s12^2 c13^2 = 0.307 * 0.9780 = 0.30025...
      term_2 = 0.30025 * 0.0086776 eV = 2.605e-3 eV
      term_3 = 0.0220 * 0.0495278 eV = 1.090e-3 eV
      m_bb^{central} = | 2.605e-3 + 1.090e-3 | eV = 3.69e-3 eV = 3.69 meV
      (both terms strictly positive at zero phase => NO cancellation => this is the funnel UPPER edge)

    Step 4 — Direction read-off (from canonical form):
      m_bb^{central} ~ 3.7 meV  <<  122 meV (KamLAND-Zen)  => below current bound (PASS direction).
      3.7 meV is inside the NO funnel [~1.5, ~4.5] meV => consistent Majorana, falsifiable at the
      LEGEND-1000 / next-gen reach floor (~6-20 meV is the design target; the funnel upper edge ~4.5
      meV sits just below it -> a sharp "next-gen-or-bust" falsifier). Majorana-phase scan LOWERS the
      band (cancellation reduces m_bb), so the central no-phase value IS the upper edge; the [lo,hi]
      band brackets the phase-induced suppression toward the funnel floor.

    Conclusion: m_bb^{central} < KamLAND-Zen AND inside the NO funnel => PASS (consistent Majorana,
                LEGEND-falsifiable). The exact substrate-pinned value is computed in-script (the
                hand-substitution above is the plan-freeze pre-flight; the script emits the float64
                value). FAIL would require m_bb > 0.122 eV, which the deep-seesaw sub-eV masses cannot
                reach -- a FAIL here would signal a texture/ordering error, not a physical overshoot.
```

## Wave 5 → Wave 6 Decision Point

Wave 5 does NOT feed Wave 6 (the Stage-2 verification cohort is independent per the partition manifest). Wave 5's downstream consumers are SESSION-LEVEL, not next-wave:

**After §W5-1 (S100a-MD-NORMALIZATION):**
- **PASS** (map unique, zero-free-parameter Sigma_mnu) → the capstone §7.3 item-(4) scorecard updates: Sigma_mnu joins the parameter-free observables; the S99 HONEST-SCOPE caveat is re-scoped to "removable." Route the capstone-prose update through the capstone-hygiene gate (Q3 status change) at session close. `canonical_constants.py` Sigma_mnu_FW provenance gains a `S100a-MD-NORMALIZATION` zero-free-parameter confirmation note.
- **INFO** (non-unique, residual Dirac scale) → the S99 track_B caveat is confirmed PERMANENT; the capstone §7.3 item-(4) records the Dirac-scale anchor as irreducibly external. No canonical-constant change (Sigma_mnu_FW value unchanged; only its provenance note gains the uniqueness-INFO finding).
- **FAIL** (Sigma_mnu > 0.12 eV) → the substrate-forward corridor is CLOSED (corridor-mapping FAIL, informative); the bottom-triple is the wrong Dirac-Yukawa source. Record in the WP §"Carry-Forward Computations" only if a DISTINCT substrate-forward map (beyond MAP-A/MAP-B) is identified as worth a future gate.

**After §W5-2 (S100a-D5-0NUBB-MAJORANA):**
- **PASS / FAIL / INFO** → in ALL cases, the m_bb value (+ band) routes to `mack-cosmic-bridge` for the falsifier-master-inventory 0nubb row landing (sole writer) at session close, per the canonical write-order (verdict file → canonical_constants.py m_bb_FW entry → inventory row). The capstone §7.3 D5 STATUS stays `unreconciled` regardless — the prose adjudication is a workshop seed (`/rclab-investigate`, Q1), NOT a gate outcome. If PASS, the WP notes the concrete LEGEND-1000 falsification target; if FAIL, the WP flags the texture/ordering inconsistency as a workshop input.

**Cross-gate (within Wave 5):** §W5-2 consumes the SAME M_R + ordering as §W5-1 and the S99 baseline. The §W5-1 track_A/track_B scale verdict informs §W5-2's INFO-caveat language (if §W5-1 returns INFO/track_B, §W5-2's m_bb absolute scale inherits the residual-Dirac-scale caveat). The two gates are independent in execution (no verdict dependency) but share the substrate seesaw configuration; run §W5-1 first if serializing, so its scale verdict is available for §W5-2's WP caveat framing. (This is a soft within-wave ordering preference, not a hard prerequisite.)
